name: OP_CHECKTEMPLATEVERIFY
summary: OP_CHECKTEMPLATEVERIFY allows an output to commit to a specific future transaction pattern. This enables covenants, vaults with time-locked recovery, payment pools, and non-interactive Lightning channel creation.
summaryZh: OP_CHECKTEMPLATEVERIFY 允许输出提交到特定的未来交易模式。支持契约、带时间锁恢复的金库、支付池和非交互式闪电通道创建。
